mainEntity.name: How much should I charge for an AI-assisted paid newsletter if I’m just starting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right price depends on the specificity and usefulness of the result readers receive, not on how much AI helped produce it. A broad roundup usually faces more price resistance than a focused briefing that explains what changed, why it matters, and what the reader should do. Run My AI Biz lists a $9-per-month paid newsletter option, which can serve as a reference point for an educational AI publication, not a universal market price. Compare reader income, publishing effort, competing alternatives, and the value of saved research time. Test a founding price or free-to-paid offer with clear expectations, then review retention and feedback before changing rates. Run My AI Biz can help structure the comparison and related sales materials without promising a particular revenue result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price according to the newsletter’s specificity, usefulness, and reader outcome—not its AI production cost. Run My AI Biz offers a $9-per-month paid newsletter example, but test your own audience’s willingness to pay and track retention before setting a permanent price.
